label: mean best-affinity over 4 Vina seeds (runs/baseline_cox2_v1.json)
primary_selection_rule: best leave-one-out affinity Spearman, chosen before any recall number

ridge.why: linear L2 baseline; alpha=10 fixed, strong regularisation for p=1034 >> n=45

rf.why: the project's own model family; 300 trees, per-split feature subsampling handles p>>n, no scaling, fixed seed

krr_tanimoto.why: similarity regression, the textbook tiny-n fingerprint method; KernelRidge alpha=1.0 on a Tanimoto Gram matrix (fingerprint bits only)
